title: Multi-Site runtime destination lookup index
opportunity: GET /api/sites searched cluster.AllDestinations with FirstOrDefault for every configured upstream, producing O(U^2) matching work for a Site with many upstreams.
implementation: Built one case-insensitive activeDestinationById dictionary per active Site cluster.
Replaced repeated destination scans with TryGetValue while preserving unknown, healthy, and unhealthy status mapping.
Added a regression contract that rejects the nested destination scan and requires the indexed lookup.

verification.broadRegression: Not rerun in full because the prior deterministic baseline remains 468/595 with 127 PostgreSQL-dependent failures at 127.0.0.1:5432; all affected Multi-Site contracts passed

boundary: Large live YARP cluster destination latency benchmark
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
